open_questions: industries/manufacturing/global-fleet/ESTATE.md:31 says Java-country employee ids are E100xxxx, but only 15 seed employees use E100 (shared people, industries/manufacturing/global-fleet/seed/jsf/002_seed.sql:4-18) and 200 use E204xxxx (e.g. industries/manufacturing/global-fleet/seed/jsf/002_seed.sql:19). Which prefix is canonical for the global app?
Mileage approval workflow: who sets APPROVED/REJECTED (seed has both, portal never writes them)? Is there an external process to be replaced?

Benefit formula: commute part is list*commute_pct/100*commute_km per month (DE 0.03% rule) prorated by days/monthDays with HALF_UP to 2dp per line; intermediate values unrounded. Confirm proration-by-days is intended (DE rule is usually per full month).
Statement default period uses server clock (previous month) and Calendar default TZ; daysBetween uses strip() to noon; confirm timezone expectations.
Statement includes assignments of employees with status 'T' and does not check leave_date; intended?
No concurrency guard: two wizard sessions can assign the same pool car (no unique partial index on assignment(vehicle_id) where end_date is null).
car_return.assignment_id has no UNIQUE; double return of same assignment is prevented only by the open==null UI flow.
Plate lookup on return page is exact and case-sensitive while the wizard normalises plates (PlateConverter); should lookup normalise too?
No authentication/authorisation in web.xml; any user can act for any employee.
